blocks.zh: 潔淨蒸汽產生器與微生物控制基礎
blocks.en: Clean Steam Generators and Fundamentals of Microbial Control

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握潔淨蒸汽產生器 (Clean Steam Generator) 的選型原理，包括壓力差與產量的關係計算
blocks.en: Understand the selection principles for Clean Steam Generators, including the calculation of the relationship between pressure differential and output

blocks.zh: 理解進水壓力、泵選型、接觸面材質對潔淨蒸汽品質的影響
blocks.en: Understand how feed water pressure, pump selection and contact surface materials affect clean steam quality

blocks.zh: 學會公用設施需求規劃：廠蒸汽流量、進水速率、電力與儀表空氣
blocks.en: Learn utility requirements planning: plant steam flow, feed water rate, electrical power and instrument air

blocks.zh: 認識定期清洗、除鏽 (Derouging) 與電導度監測的操作實務
blocks.en: Become familiar with the operating practices of periodic cleaning, derouging and conductivity monitoring

blocks.zh: 理解製藥用水系統中微生物控制的核心概念：革蘭氏陰性菌、生物膜 (Biofilm)、內毒素 (Endotoxin)
blocks.en: Understand the core concepts of microbial control in pharmaceutical water systems: Gram-negative bacteria, biofilm and endotoxin

blocks.zh: 掌握 PW 與 WFI 的微生物限量標準、警示/行動限及取樣策略
blocks.en: Master the microbial limits for PW and WFI, alert/action levels and sampling strategies

blocks.zh: 比較熱系統、冷系統、臭氧系統與紫外線 (UV) 系統的消毒設計方案
blocks.en: Compare the sanitization design options for hot systems, cold systems, ozone systems and ultraviolet (UV) systems

blocks.zh: 理解臭氧生成方法、安裝要點、與氯消毒的比較優勢
blocks.en: Understand ozone generation methods, installation points and the advantages of ozone over chlorine disinfection

blocks.zh: 掌握 UV 燈設計選型：劑量計算、低壓/中壓燈管差異、溫度與壓力限制
blocks.en: Master UV lamp design and selection: dose calculation, differences between low-pressure and medium-pressure lamps, and temperature and pressure limits

blocks.zh: 11.7 Clean Steam Generator - System Selection & Sizing 11.7 純蒸汽產生器 - 系統選擇與尺寸設計
blocks.en: 11.7 Clean Steam Generator - System Selection & Sizing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：壓力差與產量的反比關係
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Relationship Between Pressure Differential and Output

blocks.zh: 潔淨蒸汽產生器的本質就是一個熱交換器：用廠蒸汽 (Plant Steam) 加熱進水，蒸發產生潔淨蒸汽。產量取決於兩者的溫差 (ΔT)。
blocks.en: A clean steam generator is essentially a heat exchanger: it heats feed water with plant steam and evaporates it to produce clean steam. Output depends on the temperature difference (ΔT) between the two.

blocks.zh: 當你降低潔淨蒸汽壓力時，CS 的飽和溫度降低，但廠蒸汽溫度不變，所以 ΔT 增大 → 產量上升。這聽起來很好，但隱含的風險是蒸汽體積暴增、流速飆升、分離器可能無法有效攔截雜質。
blocks.en: When you lower the clean steam pressure, the CS saturation temperature drops while the plant steam temperature stays the same, so ΔT increases and output rises. This sounds attractive, but the hidden risks are a sharp increase in steam volume, a surge in velocity, and a separator that may no longer capture impurities effectively.

blocks.zh: 關鍵公式 Key Formula
blocks.en: Key Formula

blocks.zh:
W = U × A × ΔT

W = 蒸汽產量 (lbs/hr)
U = 傳熱係數 (Btu/hr/ft²/°F) -- 近似不變
A = 蒸發器面積 (ft²) -- 固定
ΔT = 廠蒸汽溫度 - CS 飽和溫度

結論：產量與 ΔT 成正比
blocks.en:
W = U × A × ΔT

W = steam output (lbs/hr)
U = heat transfer coefficient (Btu/hr/ft²/°F) -- approximately constant
A = evaporator area (ft²) -- fixed
ΔT = plant steam temperature - CS saturation temperature

Conclusion: output is proportional to ΔT

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你用大火煮一鍋水，鍋子大小固定（A 不變）、火力不變（U 不變）。如果你把鍋蓋的壓力閥調鬆（降低 CS 壓力），水的沸點降低，火焰跟沸水的溫差變大，水蒸氣產生得更快。但鍋子的排氣孔沒有變大——蒸氣衝得太快，可能把鍋裡的湯汁（雜質）一起噴出來。這就是「carryover」的道理。
blocks.en: Imagine boiling a pot of water over a high flame, with a fixed pot size (A unchanged) and constant heat output (U unchanged). If you loosen the pressure valve on the lid (lowering the CS pressure), the boiling point of the water drops, the temperature difference between the flame and the boiling water grows, and steam is generated faster. But the vent hole on the pot has not gotten any bigger, so the steam rushes out so fast that it may carry some of the liquid (impurities) out with it. That is the principle behind carryover.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ΔT > 70°F (21°C)：必須諮詢製造商，否則有 dry wall condition 風險——蒸發面過熱導致結垢 (scale)
blocks.en: ΔT > 70°F (21°C): Consult the manufacturer, otherwise there is a risk of a dry wall condition, in which overheating of the evaporating surface causes scale formation

blocks.zh: 蒸汽速度增加 300%：分離器設計未考慮這種工況時，會導致內毒素和鹽類穿透 (carryover)
blocks.en: Steam velocity increase of 300%: If the separator design did not take this operating condition into account, endotoxins and salts can pass through (carryover)

blocks.zh: 高 TDS 進水更危險：軟化水的 TDS 較高，乾壁效應會加速結垢
blocks.en: High-TDS feed water is more dangerous: Softened water has a higher TDS, and the dry wall effect accelerates scaling

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你的廠蒸汽壓力是 100 psig，潔淨蒸汽需求壓力是 45 psig，ΔT 大約多少？是否超過 70°F 的建議上限？
blocks.en: If your plant steam pressure is 100 psig and the required clean steam pressure is 45 psig, approximately what is ΔT? Does it exceed the recommended upper limit of 70°F?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 不建議在高 ΔT 下操作，即使產量可以大幅提升？這對品質風險的影響是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE not recommend operating at a high ΔT even though output can be increased substantially? What is the impact on quality risk?

blocks.zh: 11.7.1 Feed Water Pressure, Pump & Contact Surfaces 11.7.1 給水壓力、泵與接觸面
blocks.en: 11.7.1 Feed Water Pressure, Pump & Contact Surfaces

blocks.zh: 進水壓力設計邏輯
blocks.en: Feed Water Pressure Design Logic

blocks.zh: 進水壓力 = CS 壓力 + 8~10 psi。這個「多出來的壓力」用來克服管路阻力並確保水能穩定進入蒸發器。如果壓力不足，進水會不穩定，蒸汽產量波動，嚴重時甚至導致乾燒。
blocks.en: Feed water pressure = CS pressure + 8-10 psi. This "extra pressure" overcomes piping resistance and ensures water enters the evaporator steadily. If the pressure is insufficient, the feed becomes unstable, steam output fluctuates, and in severe cases the unit can even run dry.

blocks.zh: 大部分 CS 產生器的進水流量很小（2 gpm 左右），這對衛生型離心泵來說太接近關機揚程 (shutoff head)，操作在這個區域泵效率極低且容易過熱。
blocks.en: The feed water flow of most CS generators is very small (around 2 gpm), which is too close to the shutoff head for a sanitary centrifugal pump. Operating in this region is extremely inefficient for the pump and it tends to overheat.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：別過度設計進水管路
blocks.en: Key Note: Do Not Over-Design the Feed Water Piping

blocks.zh: ISPE 在這裡明確指出一個常見的過度設計陷阱：因為進水來自 WFI 或 PW 迴路，就要求所有進水管路都要 electropolish + sanitary clamp。
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly points out a common over-design trap here: because the feed water comes from a WFI or PW loop, people require all feed water piping to be electropolished with sanitary clamp connections.

blocks.zh: 實際上，進水管路的表面處理規格不需要等同於分配系統的規格，因為水進入 CS 後會被蒸發——蒸汽品質取決於蒸發器和分離器的效能，而非進水管路的粗糙度。
blocks.en: In practice, the surface finish specification of the feed water piping does not need to be equivalent to that of the distribution system, because the water is evaporated once it enters the CS. Steam quality depends on the performance of the evaporator and separator, not on the roughness of the feed water piping.

blocks.zh: 建議：在進水管路與 WFI/PW 迴路之間裝設 atmospheric break 或 backflow preventer，避免 CS 成為分配迴路的「延伸」，這樣可以降低整個迴路的驗證負擔。
blocks.en: Recommendation: Install an atmospheric break or backflow preventer between the feed water piping and the WFI/PW loop so that the CS does not become an "extension" of the distribution loop. This reduces the validation burden for the whole loop.

blocks.zh: 就像你家的自來水管接到熱水器——熱水器入口管不需要跟淨水器出水管一樣的材質等級。水進入熱水器後會被加熱消毒，入口管的光潔度對最終熱水品質影響不大。但如果你不裝逆止閥，熱水器裡的水可能回流污染冷水系統。
blocks.en: It is like the water pipe in your home connected to a water heater: the inlet pipe of the heater does not need the same material grade as the outlet pipe of a water purifier. Water is heated and disinfected after entering the heater, so the finish of the inlet pipe has little effect on the final hot water quality. But without a check valve, the water in the heater could flow back and contaminate the cold water system.

blocks.zh: 11.7.2 Utilities Requirements 11.7.2 公用設施需求
blocks.en: 11.7.2 Utilities Requirements

blocks.zh: 重點提示：TDS 與排污率的關係
blocks.en: Key Note: The Relationship Between TDS and Blowdown Rate

blocks.zh: TDS（總溶解固體）越高，蒸發器內鹽類濃縮越快，就需要更頻繁地排污 (blowdown) 來避免結垢。排污越多，進水補充就越多。這就是為什麼高 TDS 進水需要 115-120% 的進水率，而低 TDS 只需 105-110%。
blocks.en: The higher the TDS (total dissolved solids), the faster salts concentrate in the evaporator, and the more frequently blowdown is needed to prevent scaling. The more blowdown, the more feed water makeup is needed. This is why high-TDS feed water requires a feed rate of 115-120%, while low TDS needs only 105-110%.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：在 URS 階段就要確認進水水質，因為它直接影響公用設施的規模設計。如果後期從 DI 水改為軟化水，所有公用設施計算都要重來。
blocks.en: Practical advice: Confirm the feed water quality at the URS stage, because it directly affects the sizing of the utilities. If the feed is later changed from DI water to softened water, all the utility calculations have to be redone.

blocks.zh: 11.7.3 Periodic Cleaning and Derouging 11.7.3 定期清潔與除鏽
blocks.en: 11.7.3 Periodic Cleaning and Derouging

blocks.zh: Rouge（紅鏽）的本質
blocks.en: The Nature of Rouge

blocks.zh: Rouge 是不鏽鋼在高溫純水/蒸汽環境中形成的氧化鐵沉積物，外觀呈紅棕色。在 WFI 和 CS 系統中非常常見，尤其是在 80°C 以上持續運作的設備。Rouge 不一定代表系統故障，但過度積累可能影響水質、堵塞過濾器。
blocks.en: Rouge is an iron oxide deposit formed on stainless steel in high-temperature purified water/steam environments and is reddish-brown in appearance. It is very common in WFI and CS systems, especially in equipment operating continuously above 80°C. Rouge does not necessarily indicate a system failure, but excessive accumulation can affect water quality and clog filters.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：清洗化學品的選擇
blocks.en: Key Note: Choice of Cleaning Chemicals

blocks.zh: 避免硝酸鈍化 (Nitric Acid Passivation)：如果表面已經電拋光 (EP)，硝酸可能侵蝕精細的表面結構，浪費先前的投資
blocks.en: Avoid nitric acid passivation: If the surface has already been electropolished (EP), nitric acid may attack the fine surface structure and waste the earlier investment

blocks.zh: 推薦替代方案：檸檬酸 (Citric Acid) + 檸檬酸銨 (Ammonium Citrate)，溫和但有效
blocks.en: Recommended alternative: Citric acid + ammonium citrate, which is mild but effective

blocks.zh: 外包清洗時：必須要求供應商提供化學品清單，確認不會導致蝕刻 (etching)
blocks.en: When cleaning is outsourced: Require the contractor to provide a list of chemicals and confirm that they will not cause etching

blocks.zh: Rouge 就像不鏽鋼鍋具長期高溫使用後出現的彩虹色變色。你可以用溫和的清潔劑恢復，但如果用太強的酸性清潔劑（像是工業用鹽酸），反而會腐蝕鍋面。ISPE 在這裡提醒你：花大錢做的電拋光表面，一次粗暴的酸洗就前功盡棄。
blocks.en: Rouge is like the rainbow discoloration that appears on stainless steel cookware after long use at high temperature. You can restore it with a mild cleaner, but a strongly acidic cleaner (such as industrial hydrochloric acid) will corrode the surface. ISPE's reminder here is that an expensive electropolished surface can be ruined by a single harsh acid wash.

blocks.zh: 11.7.4 Conductivity Monitoring 11.7.4 電導度監控
blocks.en: 11.7.4 Conductivity Monitoring

blocks.zh: 電導度監測的邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of Conductivity Monitoring

blocks.zh: 電導度（Conductivity）反映水中離子濃度。如果 CS 冷凝水的電導度升高，代表有溶解鹽類從蒸發器「穿過」分離器進入蒸汽——這也意味著內毒素 (pyrogen) 可能一起被帶過來。
blocks.en: Conductivity reflects the ion concentration in water. If the conductivity of the CS condensate rises, dissolved salts have "passed through" the separator from the evaporator into the steam, which also means pyrogens (endotoxins) may have been carried over with them.

blocks.zh: 但有個陷阱：如果你的進水本身就是高純度 DI 水（導電度極低），那 CS 冷凝水的導電度自然也很低，即使分離器壞了也測不出差異。這就是為什麼 ISPE 說「對 DI 進水的系統，導電度監測毫無意義」。
blocks.en: But there is a catch: If your feed water is itself high-purity DI water (extremely low conductivity), the conductivity of the CS condensate will naturally be very low as well, and you will not detect any difference even if the separator has failed. This is why ISPE says that conductivity monitoring is meaningless for systems with DI feed water.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：分離器挑戰測試 (Challenge Test)
blocks.en: Key Note: Separator Challenge Test

blocks.zh: 當導電度監測不可靠時，必須主動進行挑戰測試：
blocks.en: When conductivity monitoring is unreliable, a challenge test must be performed actively:

blocks.zh: 注入亞硫酸鈉 (Sodium Sulfite)，不能用含氯鹽類（避免腐蝕不鏽鋼）
blocks.en: Inject sodium sulfite; do not use chloride-containing salts (to avoid corroding stainless steel)

blocks.zh: 進水中鹽濃度：150-200 mg/l
blocks.en: Salt concentration in the feed water: 150-200 mg/l

blocks.zh: 以 10% 排污率計算，蒸發器內部濃度可達 1,500-2,000 mg/l
blocks.en: At a 10% blowdown rate, the concentration inside the evaporator can reach 1,500-2,000 mg/l

blocks.zh: 測量 CS 冷凝水導電度，判斷分離器攔截效率
blocks.en: Measure the conductivity of the CS condensate to determine the capture efficiency of the separator

blocks.zh: 何時做？每次維修、清洗或任何可能干擾分離器結構的操作之後
blocks.en: When to perform it? After every repair, cleaning or any operation that could disturb the separator structure

blocks.zh: 你的 CS 系統使用 RO 水進水（導電度 ~5 μS/cm），冷凝水導電度突然從 1.2 升到 3.5 μS/cm。這代表什麼？你會採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: Your CS system uses RO feed water (conductivity ~5 μS/cm), and the condensate conductivity suddenly rises from 1.2 to 3.5 μS/cm. What does this mean, and what action would you take?

blocks.zh: 為什麼挑戰測試要用亞硫酸鈉而不是氯化鈉 (NaCl)？
blocks.en: Why use sodium sulfite rather than sodium chloride (NaCl) for the challenge test?

blocks.zh: 11.8.1 Bacteria in Pharmaceutical Water Systems 11.8.1 製藥用水系統中的細菌
blocks.en: 11.8.1 Bacteria in Pharmaceutical Water Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念：水系統微生物學基礎
blocks.en: Core Concept: Fundamentals of Water System Microbiology

blocks.zh: 理解製藥用水微生物控制，需要掌握三個關鍵角色：
blocks.en: To understand microbial control in pharmaceutical water, you need to grasp three key players:

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陰性菌 (Gram-negative)：純水系統的主要「居民」，能在極低營養環境中存活。殺死它們會釋放內毒素——注射劑的頭號敵人
blocks.en: Gram-negative bacteria: The main "residents" of purified water systems, able to survive in extremely low-nutrient environments. Killing them releases endotoxin, the number one enemy of injectable products

blocks.zh: 內毒素 (Endotoxin/Pyrogen)：脂多醣分子，熱穩定，比細菌本身更難去除。即使細菌被殺死，內毒素仍然存在
blocks.en: Endotoxin (pyrogen): A lipopolysaccharide molecule that is heat-stable and harder to remove than the bacteria themselves. Even after the bacteria are killed, the endotoxin remains

blocks.zh: 生物膜 (Biofilm)：細菌附著在管壁表面形成的「保護城堡」，消毒劑很難穿透
blocks.en: Biofilm: A "protective fortress" formed by bacteria attached to the pipe wall, which disinfectants find difficult to penetrate

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：生物膜如同水管內的「青苔層」
blocks.en: Analogy: Biofilm Is Like the "Algae Layer" Inside a Pipe

blocks.zh: 你可以把 biofilm 想像成魚缸壁上的那層滑膩的綠色薄膜。用漂白水泡一下可以殺死表面的藻類，但那層黏膜還在。死掉的黏膜反而成為新一批藻類的「養分」和「腳架」。所以 ISPE 強調：消毒 (disinfection) 不等於清除 (removal)。有效的策略必須包含物理去除，而不僅僅是化學殺菌。
blocks.en: Think of biofilm as the slimy green film on the wall of a fish tank. Soaking it in bleach kills the surface algae, but the slimy layer is still there. The dead layer then becomes "nutrients" and a "scaffold" for the next generation of algae. This is why ISPE stresses that disinfection is not the same as removal. An effective strategy must include physical removal, not just chemical killing.

blocks.zh: 60°C 是分水嶺：革蘭氏陰性菌無法在 60°C 以上繁殖，這就是為什麼 hot loop 設計在 75-85°C 運行
blocks.en: 60°C is the dividing line: Gram-negative bacteria cannot multiply above 60°C, which is why hot loops are designed to operate at 75-85°C

blocks.zh: 浮游菌 ≠ 生物膜菌：取水樣測到的是浮游菌 (planktonic)，生物膜中的菌量可能遠高於取樣結果
blocks.en: Planktonic bacteria ≠ biofilm bacteria: A water sample detects planktonic bacteria, while the bacterial count in the biofilm may be far higher than the sampling result suggests

blocks.zh: Pseudomonas diminuta（0.3 μm）：這就是為什麼除菌過濾器標準挑戰用 0.22 μm 濾膜——要攔截最小的已知病原菌
blocks.en: Pseudomonas diminuta (0.3 μm): This is why the standard challenge for sterilizing-grade filters uses a 0.22 μm membrane, which has to retain the smallest known pathogenic bacteria

blocks.zh: 殺菌釋放內毒素的悖論：在分配系統中殺菌反而可能增加內毒素負荷，所以 WFI 系統強調在純化階段就去除細菌，而非依賴分配系統中的熱殺菌
blocks.en: The paradox of endotoxin release on killing: Killing bacteria in a distribution system can actually increase the endotoxin load, so WFI systems emphasize removing bacteria at the purification stage rather than relying on thermal kill in the distribution system

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填的 CDMO 環境中，WFI 系統的生物膜管理是日常營運的核心挑戰之一。如果你的系統在維護後生物膜沒有被完全清除，即使取樣結果短期合格，幾天後菌量就會反彈。這就是為什麼許多 FDA 檢查員會特別關注：你的消毒 SOP 是否包含「清除」步驟，而不僅僅是「殺菌」。
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling CDMO environment, biofilm management of the WFI system is one of the core day-to-day operating challenges. If biofilm is not completely removed after maintenance, the bacterial count will rebound within a few days even if sampling results are acceptable in the short term. This is why many FDA inspectors pay particular attention to whether your sanitization SOP includes a "removal" step, and not just a "killing" step.

blocks.zh: 11.8.1.2-1.3 Microbial Levels in PW and WFI 11.8.1.2-1.3 純化水與注射用水的微生物限度
blocks.en: 11.8.1.2-1.3 Microbial Levels in PW and WFI

blocks.zh: Alert Level ≠ Action Level：Alert 是「注意，趨勢不對了」；Action 是「必須調查並採取糾正措施」。兩者都不是 pass/fail，而是管理工具
blocks.en: Alert Level ≠ Action Level: An alert level means "attention, the trend is going wrong"; an action level means "you must investigate and take corrective action." Neither is a pass/fail criterion; both are management tools

blocks.zh: 趨勢比單次結果更重要：一個持續接近 alert level 的系統，比偶爾超標一次更危險
blocks.en: Trends matter more than single results: A system that stays persistently close to its alert level is more dangerous than one that occasionally exceeds a limit once

blocks.zh: 鑑定特定微生物：不是只看總菌數，還要鑑定菌種。不同菌種指向不同污染源（Staph = 取樣問題，Bacillus = 環境污染，Gram-negative rods = 水系統本身）
blocks.en: Identify specific microorganisms: Do not look only at the total count; identify the species as well. Different species point to different contamination sources (Staph = sampling issue, Bacillus = environmental contamination, Gram-negative rods = the water system itself)

blocks.zh: 殺菌不等於除毒素：WFI 系統中殺死細菌會釋放內毒素，所以必須在純化階段就除菌，而非依賴分配迴路的高溫殺菌
blocks.en: Killing bacteria does not remove endotoxin: Killing bacteria in a WFI system releases endotoxin, so bacteria must be removed at the purification stage rather than relying on thermal kill in the distribution loop

blocks.zh: FDA 稽查重點
blocks.en: FDA Inspection Focus

blocks.zh: FDA 明確表示：PW 的 action level 超過 100 CFU/ml 是「不可接受的」。這意味著如果你的 SOP 把 action level 設在 200 CFU/ml，FDA 稽查員會直接開 observation。
blocks.en: The FDA has clearly stated that a PW action level above 100 CFU/ml is "not acceptable." This means that if your SOP sets the action level at 200 CFU/ml, an FDA inspector will issue an observation straight away.

blocks.zh: 此外，objectionable organisms 的定義是「能在藥品中生長，或在正常使用條件下引起感染的微生物」。即使總菌數合格，如果鑑定出 objectionable organism，仍然是嚴重的品質事件。
blocks.en: In addition, objectionable organisms are defined as microorganisms that can grow in the drug product or cause infection under normal conditions of use. Even if the total count is acceptable, identification of an objectionable organism is still a serious quality event.

blocks.zh: 11.8.2 Testing and Documentation 11.8.2 測試與文件
blocks.en: 11.8.2 Testing and Documentation

blocks.zh: 取樣策略設計
blocks.en: Sampling Strategy Design

blocks.zh: ISPE 的取樣建議可以歸納為以下原則：
blocks.en: ISPE's sampling recommendations can be summarized in the following principles:

blocks.zh: 輪轉取樣 (Rotational Sampling)：每天取不同使用點，確保每個點至少每週被取樣一次
blocks.en: Rotational sampling: Sample different points of use each day, ensuring each point is sampled at least once a week

blocks.zh: 模擬生產條件：取樣方式必須反映實際使用情境（用軟管的就從軟管取）
blocks.en: Simulate production conditions: The sampling method must reflect actual use (if a hose is used, sample from the hose)

blocks.zh: 多點取樣的價值：如果某天只取一個點且超標，你無法判斷是局部問題還是系統性問題
blocks.en: Value of multi-point sampling: If only one point is sampled on a given day and it exceeds the limit, you cannot tell whether the problem is local or systemic

blocks.zh: 最壞情況取樣：在消毒前取樣，代表系統最差狀態
blocks.en: Worst-case sampling: Sample before sanitization, which represents the worst state of the system

blocks.zh: 重點提示：低營養培養基的必要性
blocks.en: Key Note: The Need for Low-Nutrient Media

blocks.zh: 水系統中的細菌已經「習慣」了極低營養環境。如果你用標準 TSA（高營養培養基）培養它們，就像把沙漠中的仙人掌突然丟進熱帶雨林——它們會因為「營養過度衝擊」而死亡，導致培養結果偏低。
blocks.en: Bacteria in water systems have become "accustomed" to extremely low-nutrient environments. If you culture them on standard TSA (a high-nutrient medium), it is like suddenly dropping a desert cactus into a rainforest: they die from "nutrient shock," and the culture result comes out low.

blocks.zh: 常用低營養培養基：R2A agar（孵育 5-7 天，25-30°C）。這比 TSA 更能反映水系統的真實微生物負荷。
blocks.en: Commonly used low-nutrient medium: R2A agar (incubation 5-7 days at 25-30°C). It reflects the true microbial load of a water system better than TSA.

blocks.zh: OOS 調查中的菌種鑑定指南
blocks.en: Guide to Microbial Identification in OOS Investigations

blocks.zh: 菌種鑑定是調查 OOS 的「指紋證據」——它能快速把調查方向從「到處找」聚焦到「精準打擊」。
blocks.en: Microbial identification is the "fingerprint evidence" of an OOS investigation: it quickly narrows the investigation from "searching everywhere" to "precision targeting."

blocks.zh: 11.8.3-11.8.4 Sanitization Designs & Hot System Distribution Loop 11.8.3-11.8.4 消毒設計與熱水分配迴路
blocks.en: 11.8.3-11.8.4 Sanitization Designs & Hot System Distribution Loop

blocks.zh: 熱系統設計核心要點
blocks.en: Core Points of Hot System Design

blocks.zh: 熱水循環系統的最大優勢是「自消毒 (self-sanitizing)」——只要維持 75-85°C，革蘭氏陰性菌無法存活。但這個溫度窗口有兩個邊界：
blocks.en: The greatest advantage of a hot water circulation system is that it is "self-sanitizing": as long as 75-85°C is maintained, Gram-negative bacteria cannot survive. But this temperature window has two boundaries:

blocks.zh: 下限 75°C：低於此溫度，部分耐熱菌可能存活
blocks.en: Lower limit 75°C: Below this temperature, some heat-resistant bacteria may survive

blocks.zh: 上限 85-87°C：超過此溫度，Rouge（紅鏽）加速形成，且泵可能因接近沸點而汽蝕 (cavitation)
blocks.en: Upper limit 85-87°C: Above this temperature, rouge formation accelerates, and pumps may cavitate because they are close to the boiling point

blocks.zh: 重點提示：溫度管理的兩難
blocks.en: Key Note: The Temperature Management Dilemma

blocks.zh: 蒸餾出水溫度可達 96°C：必須在儲罐設計中考慮冷卻能力，否則泵會汽蝕
blocks.en: Distillation outlet water can reach 96°C: Cooling capacity must be considered in the storage tank design, otherwise the pump will cavitate

blocks.zh: Rouge 風險在 87°C 以上急升：需要在「殺菌效果」和「材料壽命」間取得平衡
blocks.en: Rouge risk rises sharply above 87°C: A balance must be struck between "sanitization effectiveness" and "material life"

blocks.zh: 維護後重新消毒：使用等級不低於系統水質的 80°C 熱水，沖洗 2-3 倍系統容量
blocks.en: Re-sanitization after maintenance: Flush with 2-3 system volumes of 80°C hot water of a quality no lower than that of the system water

blocks.zh: 升溫時間 2-4 小時：必須在 URS 中明確規定，影響夾套換熱器和蒸汽供應的設計
blocks.en: Heat-up time of 2-4 hours: This must be specified clearly in the URS, as it affects the design of the jacketed heat exchanger and the steam supply

blocks.zh: 熱水循環系統就像你家的中央暖氣——暖氣水在管路中持續循環保持高溫，細菌就像冬天試圖在暖氣管裡結冰的水滴，只要溫度夠高就不可能存在。但如果暖氣停了一段時間（維護停機），重新啟動時你需要先用最熱的水沖洗整個系統，確保每個角落都被燙過。
blocks.en: A hot water circulation system is like the central heating in your home: the heating water circulates continuously through the pipes to stay hot, and bacteria are like water droplets trying to freeze inside a heating pipe in winter, which cannot exist as long as the temperature is high enough. But if the heating is off for a while (a maintenance shutdown), when restarting you need to flush the whole system with the hottest water first to make sure every corner is heated.

blocks.zh: 安全提醒
blocks.en: Safety Reminder

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調：所有外露管路和儲罐表面必須保溫隔熱。80°C 的水接觸皮膚會造成嚴重燙傷。消毒週期中，所有使用點必須有人監控。這不僅是 GMP 要求，更是 EHS（環境健康安全）的基本責任。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically emphasizes that all exposed piping and tank surfaces must be insulated. Water at 80°C causes severe scalds on contact with skin. During a sanitization cycle, all points of use must be attended. This is not only a GMP requirement but also a basic EHS (environment, health and safety) responsibility.

blocks.zh: 11.8.5 Cold System Design 11.8.5 冷系統設計
blocks.en: 11.8.5 Cold System Design

blocks.zh: 冷系統消毒設計邏輯
blocks.en: Sanitization Design Logic for Cold Systems

blocks.zh: 冷系統在常溫運行，沒有熱系統的「自消毒」優勢，因此需要定期升溫消毒。設計的核心是兩個換熱器：
blocks.en: A cold system operates at ambient temperature and lacks the "self-sanitizing" advantage of a hot system, so it requires periodic heat-up sanitization. The core of the design is two heat exchangers:

blocks.zh: 冷卻換熱器：安裝在分配泵之後，日常運行時將水冷卻到使用溫度
blocks.en: Cooling heat exchanger: Installed after the distribution pump, it cools the water to the use temperature during routine operation

blocks.zh: 加熱換熱器：安裝在回水管路、儲罐之前，消毒時將水加熱到 80°C
blocks.en: Heating heat exchanger: Installed in the return line before the storage tank, it heats the water to 80°C during sanitization

blocks.zh: 使用 double tube sheet 設計是為了避免公用介質（冷卻水/蒸汽）與製藥用水之間的交叉污染——即使一側管板洩漏，中間的排放空間也能防止混合。
blocks.en: A double tube sheet design is used to avoid cross-contamination between the utility medium (cooling water/steam) and the pharmaceutical water: even if one tube sheet leaks, the drain space in between prevents mixing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：熱衝擊 (Thermal Shock)
blocks.en: Key Note: Thermal Shock

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調冷卻必須「非常緩慢」，以防止熱衝擊。快速降溫可能導致：
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that cooling must be "very slow" to prevent thermal shock. Rapid cooling may cause:

blocks.zh: 管路焊縫熱應力裂紋
blocks.en: Thermal stress cracks in pipe welds

blocks.zh: 閥門密封件收縮洩漏
blocks.en: Shrinkage and leakage of valve seals

blocks.zh: 儀表膜片損壞
blocks.en: Damage to instrument diaphragms

blocks.zh: 在 SOP 中應規定降溫速率（例如每分鐘不超過 2-3°C），並在 PQ 中驗證。
blocks.en: The cooling rate (for example, no more than 2-3°C per minute) should be specified in the SOP and verified in the PQ.

blocks.zh: 如果你的冷系統只使用一個換熱器同時負責加熱和冷卻，設計上需要注意哪些額外事項？
blocks.en: If your cold system uses only one heat exchanger for both heating and cooling, what additional design considerations are needed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼要在回水管路（而非出水管路）安裝加熱換熱器？這對消毒效果有何影響？
blocks.en: Why is the heating heat exchanger installed in the return line (rather than the supply line)? What is the effect on sanitization effectiveness?

blocks.zh: 11.8.6 Ozone System 11.8.6 臭氧系統
blocks.en: 11.8.6 Ozone System

blocks.zh: 臭氧系統核心優勢
blocks.en: Core Advantages of Ozone Systems

blocks.zh: 臭氧在製藥用水消毒中有三大無可比擬的優勢：
blocks.en: Ozone has three unmatched advantages for pharmaceutical water disinfection:

blocks.zh: 極快殺菌速度：0.1-0.2 mg/l 濃度即可將微生物控制到 <1 CFU/100ml，且秒級殺菌（vs 氯需 400+ 小時）
blocks.en: Extremely fast kill rate: A concentration of 0.1-0.2 mg/l controls microorganisms to <1 CFU/100ml, with kill in seconds (vs 400+ hours for chlorine)

blocks.zh: 無殘留副產物：分解後只剩 O&sub2 和 CO&sub2，不像氯會產生致癌性的含氯副產物
blocks.en: No residual by-products: After decomposition only O&sub2 and CO&sub2 remain, unlike chlorine, which produces carcinogenic chlorinated by-products

blocks.zh: 自然分解：半衰期 20-100 分鐘，使用點前自然或強制去除即可
blocks.en: Natural decomposition: Half-life of 20-100 minutes; it can be removed naturally or by forced removal before the point of use

blocks.zh: 重點提示：臭氧系統設計注意事項
blocks.en: Key Note: Ozone System Design Considerations

blocks.zh: 材料選擇：PVC 會被臭氧侵蝕，必須使用 PVDF 或 PTFE 墊片和管件
blocks.en: Material selection: PVC is attacked by ozone; PVDF or PTFE gaskets and fittings must be used

blocks.zh: Corona Discharge 的陷阱：進氣中氮氣和水分過高會產生硝酸，降低水的 pH 和導電度，並腐蝕不鏽鋼。必須配乾燥器和分子篩
blocks.en: The corona discharge trap: Excess nitrogen and moisture in the feed gas produce nitric acid, which lowers the pH and conductivity of the water and corrodes stainless steel. A dryer and molecular sieve must be provided

blocks.zh: 注入位置：在回水管路（迴路回到儲罐之前），而非出水端。這樣整個迴路都能被消毒
blocks.en: Injection location: In the return line (before the loop returns to the tank), not at the outlet side, so that the entire loop is disinfected

blocks.zh: 去除位置：在第一個使用點之前，確保臭氧不會進入產品
blocks.en: Removal location: Before the first point of use, to ensure ozone does not enter the product

blocks.zh: 環境監測：臭氧對人體有害，必須監測周圍空氣中的臭氧濃度（OSHA PEL: 0.1 ppm）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring: Ozone is harmful to humans, so the ozone concentration in the surrounding air must be monitored (OSHA PEL: 0.1 ppm)

blocks.zh: 臭氧消毒就像用紫外線消毒水瓶——效果立竿見影，而且用完不會留下任何化學殘留。氯消毒則像在水裡加漂白水——確實能殺菌，但你事後要花很大力氣把漂白水的味道和殘留物去掉，而且漂白水可能在水中產生有害的副產物。
blocks.en: Ozone disinfection is like using ultraviolet light to disinfect a water bottle: the effect is immediate, and no chemical residue is left afterward. Chlorine disinfection is like adding bleach to the water: it does kill bacteria, but afterward you must put considerable effort into removing the bleach smell and residues, and the bleach may produce harmful by-products in the water.

blocks.zh: 11.8.7 UV Light 11.8.7 紫外光
blocks.en: 11.8.7 UV Light

blocks.zh: UV 消毒系統核心知識
blocks.en: Core Knowledge of UV Disinfection Systems

blocks.zh: UV 消毒的原理是利用 254 nm 波長的紫外光破壞微生物的 DNA，使其無法繁殖。關鍵在於「直接照射」——任何遮蔽物（懸浮固體、氣泡）都會產生「陰影區」，降低殺菌效果。
blocks.en: UV disinfection works by using 254 nm ultraviolet light to damage the DNA of microorganisms so that they cannot reproduce. The key is "direct irradiation": any obstruction (suspended solids, air bubbles) creates a "shadow zone" and reduces the disinfection effect.

blocks.zh: UV 劑量計算
blocks.en: UV Dose Calculation

blocks.zh:
D10 = 1 log 殺滅所需劑量 (mW·s/cm²)

E. Coli: D10 = 3 mW·s/cm²
  1 log (90% kill) = 3 mW·s/cm²
  2 log (99% kill) = 2 × D10 = 6 mW·s/cm²
  3 log (99.9% kill) = 3 × D10 = 9 mW·s/cm²

製藥水系統最低劑量：30 mW·s/cm²
（相當於 E. Coli 的 10 log 殺滅能力）

設計規則：在燈管壽命末期 (EOL) 仍能
達到最低劑量要求 → 需內建安全裕度
blocks.en:
D10 = dose required for 1 log kill (mW·s/cm²)

E. coli: D10 = 3 mW·s/cm²
  1 log (90% kill) = 3 mW·s/cm²
  2 log (99% kill) = 2 × D10 = 6 mW·s/cm²
  3 log (99.9% kill) = 3 × D10 = 9 mW·s/cm²

Minimum dose for pharmaceutical water systems: 30 mW·s/cm²
(equivalent to a 10 log kill capability for E. coli)

Design rule: the minimum dose requirement must still be
met at the end of lamp life (EOL) → a built-in safety margin is required

blocks.zh: UV 不取代定期消毒：UV 是「持續控制」手段，不是「一勞永逸」方案。系統仍需定期熱消毒或化學消毒
blocks.en: UV does not replace periodic sanitization: UV is a "continuous control" measure, not a "once and for all" solution. The system still requires periodic thermal or chemical sanitization

blocks.zh: 水平安裝：避免氣袋 (air pocket) 形成，氣袋會遮擋 UV 光並產生消毒死角
blocks.en: Horizontal installation: Avoids the formation of air pockets, which block UV light and create sanitization dead zones

blocks.zh: 連續監測：UV 強度和頻率必須即時監測並記錄，作為系統正常運行的證據
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring: UV intensity and frequency must be monitored and recorded in real time as evidence of normal system operation

blocks.zh: 石英套管 (Quartz Sleeve)：需定期清潔，水垢和 biofilm 會在套管表面積累，降低透光率
blocks.en: Quartz sleeve: Must be cleaned periodically, as scale and biofilm accumulate on the sleeve surface and reduce light transmittance

blocks.zh: 循環速率：整個儲罐/迴路容量每小時至少循環 4-6 次，以確保累積劑量足夠
blocks.en: Circulation rate: The entire tank/loop volume should be circulated at least 4-6 times per hour to ensure sufficient accumulated dose

blocks.zh: EOL 設計：UV 燈會隨時間衰減，選型時必須確保即使在燈管壽命末期，輸出劑量仍 ≥ 30 mW·s/cm²
blocks.en: EOL design: UV lamps decay over time, so selection must ensure that the output dose is still ≥ 30 mW·s/cm² at the end of lamp life

blocks.zh: 你的 WFI 系統是 80°C 熱循環設計，還需要安裝 UV 嗎？如果需要，應該選低壓還是中壓燈管？
blocks.en: Your WFI system is a hot circulation design at 80°C. Do you still need to install UV? If so, should you choose low-pressure or medium-pressure lamps?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 PW 系統流量最大為 50 GPM，水質很乾淨（UV 透過率 >98%），你會如何選型 UV 設備？需要考慮哪些參數？
blocks.en: If your PW system has a maximum flow of 50 GPM and very clean water (UV transmittance >98%), how would you select the UV equipment? What parameters must be considered?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 說「UV 消毒不能取代定期消毒」？UV 系統有哪些 biofilm 管理上的局限性？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE say that "UV disinfection cannot replace periodic sanitization"? What are the limitations of UV systems in biofilm management?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CS 產生器選型核心：產量與 ΔT 成正比 (W = U × A × ΔT)，但 ΔT > 70°F 有乾壁風險，低壓操作會導致蒸汽流速暴增 300%，引發 carryover
blocks.en: Core of CS generator selection: Output is proportional to ΔT (W = U × A × ΔT), but ΔT > 70°F carries a dry wall risk, and low-pressure operation causes a 300% surge in steam velocity, leading to carryover

blocks.zh: 進水設計務實原則：進水壓力 = CS 壓力 + 8-10 psi；進水管路不需要與分配系統同等級表面處理；使用 atmospheric break 或 backflow preventer 與源水迴路隔離
blocks.en: Pragmatic principles for feed water design: Feed water pressure = CS pressure + 8-10 psi; feed water piping does not need the same surface finish as the distribution system; use an atmospheric break or backflow preventer to isolate it from the source water loop

blocks.zh: 公用設施計算：廠蒸汽流量 110-120% CS 產量，壓力高出 50-60 psig；進水率 105-120% 取決於 TDS
blocks.en: Utility calculations: Plant steam flow 110-120% of CS output, with pressure 50-60 psig higher; feed rate 105-120% depending on TDS

blocks.zh: Rouge 與清洗：避免硝酸鈍化已電拋光表面，推薦檸檬酸 + 檸檬酸銨。外包清洗需審查化學品
blocks.en: Rouge and cleaning: Avoid nitric acid passivation of electropolished surfaces; citric acid + ammonium citrate is recommended. Outsourced cleaning requires review of the chemicals

blocks.zh: 電導度監測局限：對 DI 進水系統無效，需進行分離器挑戰測試（亞硫酸鈉 150-200 mg/l）
blocks.en: Limitations of conductivity monitoring: Ineffective for DI feed water systems; a separator challenge test (sodium sulfite 150-200 mg/l) is required

blocks.zh: 微生物控制三要素：Gram-negative 菌（60°C 以上無法繁殖）、Endotoxin（殺菌後仍殘留）、Biofilm（消毒不等於清除）
blocks.en: Three elements of microbial control: Gram-negative bacteria (cannot multiply above 60°C), endotoxin (remains after killing), biofilm (disinfection is not removal)

blocks.zh: PW Action Level 100 CFU/ml、WFI 10 CFU/100ml：菌種鑑定是 OOS 調查的關鍵線索
blocks.en: PW action level 100 CFU/ml, WFI 10 CFU/100ml: Microbial identification is a key lead in OOS investigations

blocks.zh: 消毒系統選擇：熱系統 75-85°C 自消毒；冷系統需雙管板換熱器定期升溫；臭氧秒級殺菌無殘留；UV 254 nm 持續控制但不取代定期消毒
blocks.en: Choice of sanitization system: Hot systems self-sanitize at 75-85°C; cold systems need double tube sheet heat exchangers and periodic heat-up; ozone kills in seconds with no residue; UV at 254 nm provides continuous control but does not replace periodic sanitization

blocks.zh: 臭氧優勢：0.1-0.2 mg/l 即可控菌 <1 CFU/100ml，殺菌速度比氯快數千倍，無致癌副產物
blocks.en: Ozone advantages: 0.1-0.2 mg/l controls bacteria to <1 CFU/100ml, kills thousands of times faster than chlorine, with no carcinogenic by-products

blocks.zh: UV 設計要點：最低 30 mW·s/cm² 劑量，EOL 仍需達標；循環率 ≥ 4 次/小時；水平安裝避氣袋；連續監測強度
blocks.en: UV design essentials: Minimum dose of 30 mW·s/cm², which must still be met at EOL; circulation rate ≥ 4 times/hour; horizontal installation to avoid air pockets; continuous intensity monitoring
